rules.title: AWS access key ID in source
rules.explanation: A 20-character string matching the AWS access key ID format appears in a file. Access key IDs are credentials: anyone who reads the repository may be able to use them.
rules.remediation: Revoke the key in IAM, then load the replacement from the environment or a secret manager. Rotate first: removing the line does not un-leak the credential.

rules.title: Private key material committed to the repository
rules.explanation: A PEM private key header appears in a tracked file. A committed private key must be treated as compromised even if the commit is later amended.
rules.remediation: Rotate the key pair, remove the material from the repository, and load keys from a secret store or local untracked path.

rules.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.explanation: The file turns off certificate verification. Traffic that should fail on an invalid certificate is instead accepted, which removes protection against interception.
rules.remediation: Remove the override. For local development, trust a development CA instead of disabling verification, and never ship the override in production code paths.

rules.title: Unescaped HTML injection sink
rules.explanation: Raw HTML is written into the DOM. This is only a defect when the value can carry untrusted input; text matching cannot decide that, so evidence stays `suspected`.
rules.remediation: Render text through normal escaping, or sanitize the HTML at the boundary with a maintained sanitizer before it reaches the sink.

rules.title: Subprocess spawned with a shell
rules.explanation: A process is spawned with shell interpretation enabled. If an interpolated argument reaches it, shell metacharacters become executable syntax.
rules.remediation: Spawn with an argument array and leave the shell disabled; pass user input as arguments, not as command text.

rules.title: Unresolved task marker
rules.explanation: A `TODO`/`FIXME` marker was found. This is a bookkeeping observation, not a bug: it is reported so the total is visible, not scored.
rules.remediation: Convert the note into a tracked issue, or delete the stale note.
